description: This file defines the 'IShell' interface within the WPEFramework namespace, including nested classes, enums, and method signatures for plugin and shell management, remote connections, and subsystem interactions.

classes.name: IShell
classes.description: Main interface for shell interactions in plugin host environment, providing methods for plugin management, remote connections, and subsystem access.

classes.name: IShell::ICOMLink
classes.description: Interface for managing inter-process COM links, including registration of notifications and remote connection handling.

classes.name: IShell::INotification
classes.description: Interface for monitoring dangling and revoked remote connections.

classes.name: IShell::Job
classes.description: Represents a dispatch job to activate or deactivate a plugin shell, implementing the Core::IDispatch interface.
